#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="/root/savant-runtime"

EXILES="${ROOT}/ontology/obelisks/_template/segue/gates/_template/segue/innates/_template/segue/exiles"

OPUS="${EXILES}/opus"
ENVOY="${EXILES}/envoy"
PALAVER="${EXILES}/palaver"
NICHE="${EXILES}/niche"
CODA="${EXILES}/coda"
NOTARY="${EXILES}/notary"

pass() {
    printf 'PASS  %s\n' "$1"
}

fail() {
    printf 'FAIL  %s\n' "$1"
}

unknown() {
    printf 'UNKNOWN  %s\n' "$1"
}

printf '%s\n' \
    '=== SAVANT SELF-HOSTED MIGRATION GATE ==='

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 1. CANON / TASK AUTHORITY ==='

if [ -f "${ROOT}/authority/task-graph/masterplan.json" ]; then
    pass "authoritative task graph present"
elif [ -f "${ROOT}/masterplan.json" ]; then
    pass "masterplan projection present"
else
    fail "Masterplan/task graph unavailable"
fi

if [ -f "${ROOT}/canon-system/runtime/canon.sqlite3" ]; then
    pass "fluid canon database present"
else
    fail "fluid canon database absent"
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 2. LORE / SCRYBE ==='

if [ -x "${ROOT}/lore_scrybe_fluid_canon_final_verify.sh" ]; then
    if "${ROOT}/lore_scrybe_fluid_canon_final_verify.sh" >/tmp/savant_lore_gate.out 2>&1; then
        cat /tmp/savant_lore_gate.out
        pass "Lore/Scrybe/fluid-canon integration"
    else
        cat /tmp/savant_lore_gate.out
        fail "Lore/Scrybe/fluid-canon integration"
    fi
else
    fail "Lore/Scrybe final verifier missing"
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 3. OPUS TEXT INFERENCE ==='

OPUS_RUNTIME="${OPUS}/runtime"

if [ ! -f "${OPUS_RUNTIME}/router.py" ]; then
    fail "Opus router missing"
else
    PYTHONPATH="${OPUS_RUNTIME}" \
    python3 - <<'PY'
import json

try:
    from router import select_provider
except Exception as exc:
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "passed": False,
                "stage": "import",
                "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
                "error": str(exc),
            },
            sort_keys=True,
        )
    )
    raise SystemExit(1)

try:
    provider = select_provider(
        "text_inference_route"
    )
except Exception as exc:
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "passed": False,
                "stage": "selection",
                "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
                "error": str(exc),
            },
            sort_keys=True,
        )
    )
    raise SystemExit(1)

print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "passed": True,
            "route": "text_inference_route",
            "provider": provider.get("id"),
            "credentials": "resolved-by-opus",
        },
        sort_keys=True,
    )
)
PY

    if [ "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" -eq 0 ]; then
        pass "Opus text inference provider resolution"
    else
        fail "Opus text inference provider resolution"
    fi
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 4. OPUS EXECUTION API ==='

python3 - "${OPUS_RUNTIME}/router.py" <<'PY'
import ast
import sys
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(sys.argv[1])

if not path.is_file():
    raise SystemExit(1)

tree = ast.parse(
    path.read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"
    )
)

functions = {
    node.name
    for node in ast.walk(tree)
    if isinstance(
        node,
        (
            ast.FunctionDef,
            ast.AsyncFunctionDef,
        ),
    )
}

required = {
    "select_provider",
    "execute_text_request",
}

print(
    {
        "functions": sorted(
            required & functions
        ),
        "missing": sorted(
            required - functions
        ),
        "passed": required <= functions,
    }
)

raise SystemExit(
    0
    if required <= functions
    else 1
)
PY

if [ "$?" -eq 0 ]; then
    pass "Opus provider selection + text execution surface"
else
    fail "Opus text execution surface incomplete"
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 5. OROBOUROS LIVE IMPLEMENTATION ==='

find \
    "${ENVOY}" \
    -type f \
    \( \
        -iname '*orobouros*' \
        -o -iname '*persona*' \
        -o -iname '*trait*' \
        -o -iname '*crown*' \
    \) \
    ! -path '*/__pycache__/*' \
    ! -path '*/node_modules/*' \
    2>/dev/null \
    | sort \
    | head -n 120

ORO_COUNT="$(
    find \
        "${ENVOY}" \
        -type f \
        \( \
            -iname '*orobouros*' \
            -o -iname '*persona*' \
            -o -iname '*trait*' \
            -o -iname '*crown*' \
            -o -iname '*living*trait*' \
        \) \
        ! -path '*/__pycache__/*' \
        ! -path '*/node_modules/*' \
        2>/dev/null \
        | wc -l
)"

if [ "${ORO_COUNT}" -gt 0 ]; then
    pass "Orobouros-related live files present (${ORO_COUNT})"
else
    fail "Orobouros runtime implementation absent"
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 6. OROBOUROS REQUIRED INVARIANTS ==='

grep -RIl \
    --exclude='*.pyc' \
    --exclude-dir='__pycache__' \
    --exclude-dir='node_modules' \
    -E \
    'baseline|Living Trait Crown|living_trait|trait_crown|adaptive.*trait|trait.*cap' \
    "${ENVOY}" \
    2>/dev/null \
    | sort \
    | head -n 80 \
    || true

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 7. PALAVER DEFAULT PERSONA ==='

PALAVER_ORO="$(
    grep -RIl \
        --exclude='*.pyc' \
        --exclude-dir='__pycache__' \
        --exclude-dir='node_modules' \
        --exclude-dir='dist' \
        -E \
        'Orobouros|orobouros' \
        "${PALAVER}" \
        2>/dev/null \
        | head -n 20 \
        || true
)"

if [ -n "${PALAVER_ORO}" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "${PALAVER_ORO}"
    pass "Palaver contains Orobouros binding/reference"
else
    fail "Palaver has no proven Orobouros binding"
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 8. NICHE TASK RUNTIME ==='

find \
    "${NICHE}/runtime" \
    -maxdepth 3 \
    -type f \
    -name '*.py' \
    ! -path '*/__pycache__/*' \
    2>/dev/null \
    | sort \
    | head -n 100

NICHE_TASK="$(
    grep -RIl \
        --exclude='*.pyc' \
        --exclude-dir='__pycache__' \
        -E \
        'lease|transition|task.*state|task.*queue|masterplan' \
        "${NICHE}/runtime" \
        2>/dev/null \
        | head -n 20 \
        || true
)"

if [ -n "${NICHE_TASK}" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "${NICHE_TASK}"
    pass "Niche task-governance runtime surface present"
else
    fail "Niche task-governance runtime not proven"
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 9. CODA MUTATION ==='

if [ -f "${CODA}/runtime/mutation.py" ]; then
    python3 -m py_compile \
        "${CODA}/runtime/mutation.py"

    if grep -q \
        'def replace_text' \
        "${CODA}/runtime/mutation.py"
    then
        pass "Coda durable mutation API"
    else
        fail "Coda mutation API lacks replace_text"
    fi
else
    fail "Coda mutation runtime missing"
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 10. NOTARY VERIFICATION ==='

NOTARY_FILES="$(
    find \
        "${NOTARY}/runtime" \
        -maxdepth 2 \
        -type f \
        -name '*.py' \
        ! -path '*/__pycache__/*' \
        2>/dev/null \
        | sort
)"

printf '%s\n' "${NOTARY_FILES}"

if [ -n "${NOTARY_FILES}" ]; then
    pass "Notary runtime present"
else
    fail "Notary runtime absent"
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 11. PALAVER DEVELOPMENT SURFACE ==='

PALAVER_DEV="$(
    grep -RIl \
        --exclude='*.pyc' \
        --exclude-dir='__pycache__' \
        --exclude-dir='node_modules' \
        --exclude-dir='dist' \
        -E \
        'Monaco|file tree|repository|workspace|patch|terminal|command palette|editor' \
        "${PALAVER}" \
        2>/dev/null \
        | head -n 40 \
        || true
)"

if [ -n "${PALAVER_DEV}" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "${PALAVER_DEV}"
    pass "Palaver development/workstation capability present"
else
    fail "Palaver development surface not proven"
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== 12. CURRENT BLOCKERS ==='

BLOCKERS=0

if ! PYTHONPATH="${OPUS_RUNTIME}" \
    python3 -c '
from router import select_provider
select_provider("text_inference_route")
' >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    printf '%s\n' \
        'BLOCKER: opus_text_inference'
    BLOCKERS=$((BLOCKERS + 1))
fi

if [ "${ORO_COUNT}" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' \
        'BLOCKER: orobouros_runtime'
    BLOCKERS=$((BLOCKERS + 1))
fi

if [ -z "${PALAVER_ORO}" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' \
        'BLOCKER: palaver_orobouros_default'
    BLOCKERS=$((BLOCKERS + 1))
fi

if [ -z "${NICHE_TASK}" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' \
        'BLOCKER: niche_task_runtime'
    BLOCKERS=$((BLOCKERS + 1))
fi

if [ ! -f "${CODA}/runtime/mutation.py" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' \
        'BLOCKER: coda_mutation'
    BLOCKERS=$((BLOCKERS + 1))
fi

if [ -z "${NOTARY_FILES}" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' \
        'BLOCKER: notary_runtime'
    BLOCKERS=$((BLOCKERS + 1))
fi

printf '\n%s\n' \
    '=== RESULT ==='

printf 'blocking_gap_count=%s\n' \
    "${BLOCKERS}"

if [ "${BLOCKERS}" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' \
        'SELF-HOSTED DEVELOPMENT CORE: structurally ready'
else
    printf '%s\n' \
        'SELF-HOSTED DEVELOPMENT CORE: implementation gaps remain'
fi
